description: An editorial mandate for an AI-assisted newsroom agent that drafts and publishes a story. The chain runs sources_gathered -> content_drafted -> content_fact_checked -> (editor_signed_off?) -> content_published (sign-off and fact-check are optional actions; sourcing, drafting, and publishing are required). Two conformance levers: sources_gathered must name a primary_source and every source it lists (the required primary_source plus any additional_sources) must be one of allowed_sources (a story built on an off-allowlist source is nonconformant, and a story that names no source at all cannot even be sealed because primary_source is required), and the published story's signoff_status must be "signed_off" (a story auto-published without a human editor sign-off is nonconformant). The two are independent: an off-allowlist source fails even a signed-off story, and an auto-published story fails even one built entirely on allowlisted sources. A conditional requirement closes the honesty gap: any content_published that claims signoff_status "signed_off" MUST be preceded by an editor_signed_off action, so the published claim cannot assert a sign-off that never happened. The story is bound end to end (evidence_bindings): the fact-check, the sign-off, and the publish must all carry the SAME content_hash and story_ref that were drafted, so a chain cannot draft one story and publish a different one. Evidence is closed (additionalProperties:false). The article text and the model prompt are sealed only as sha256 hashes (content_hash, prompt_hash); the sources, model id, editor reference, claims-checked count, and sign-off status are public masthead facts sealed in the clear. The verifier enforces the shape, the allowlist, the sign-off status, the conditional requirement, and the bindings.
